name: integer_2pow63_rejected_on_ingest
description: The tight encode-side boundary: 2^63 (9223372036854775808, one past int64 max) presented as a bare-integer JSON literal MUST raise an out-of-range error on ingest, while 2^63-1 ingests exactly (021). Conformance is on the interval bound, not magnitude (SPEC 2.3.2).
